_doc.purpose: Master terminology dictionary. Single source of truth for canonical labels used across Projects, Financials, CRM, HR, Timesheet, Forecast and Permissions.
_doc.rule: Modules MUST reference these keys via t('glossary:<group>.<term>') instead of redeclaring the same concept locally.
_doc.ptCanonical: When the EN UI renders a term that has a Portuguese legal/payroll canonical form, render it as 'EN label (PT canonical)' on first occurrence using <Term k='...' /> — see ptCanonical field per term.

ptCanonical._doc: Canonical Portuguese legal/payroll terms. EN UI renders 'EN label (PT canonical)' on first occurrence via <Term> component. Never translate these away — they are legal terms.

_ambiguous._doc: Terms flagged for product clarification — currently used inconsistently across the app. Do NOT use these as canonical until resolved.
_ambiguous.value: Used to mean (a) proposal monetary value, (b) generic numeric value, (c) project budget. Standardize: proposal → 'Proposal Value', budget → 'Budget', generic numbers → context-specific.
_ambiguous.usage: Sometimes means 'utilization', sometimes 'capacity used'. Standardize: 'Utilization' (ratio) vs 'Capacity Used' (absolute hours).
_ambiguous.worked: Sometimes means 'logged', sometimes 'billable'. Standardize on 'Logged Hours' for raw time recorded.
_ambiguous.registered: PT 'registadas' translates to 'logged' — never use 'registered hours' in EN UI.
_ambiguous.rate: Ambiguous between cost rate and sale rate. Always disambiguate: 'Cost Rate' or 'Sale Rate'.
_ambiguous.team: Used as both (a) the Resources/People list, (b) a permission scope, (c) a department-like grouping. Confirm: should the resources page be renamed 'People' to free 'Team' for the scope?
_ambiguous.client: DB uses 'Company' for the entity, 'Client' as a marketing label. Standardize: entity = 'Company', commercial label = 'Client' (UI-facing only).
_ambiguous.fee: PT-only legal/business term ('Fee', 'Proposta de Fee') retained even in EN UI per Portuguese practice. Confirm if EN-only contexts should map to 'Professional Fee' instead.
